name: ikmal-editor-vscode
description: Local grammar and style diagnostics backed by ikmal editor.

commands.title: ikmal: Zen mode (only the most confident findings)

ikmal.enabled.description: Check text documents with the local ikmal service.

ikmal.endpoint.description: Loopback URL for the ikmal quality proxy.

ikmal.language.description: Language code sent to the local checker.

ikmal.minLength.description: Minimum non-whitespace text length to check.

ikmal.maxLength.description: Maximum document length sent to the local checker.

ikmal.enabledLanguages.description: Language IDs that ikmal checks. An empty list checks every editable language.

ikmal.dictionary.description: Words treated as intentional spelling, kept in VS Code settings.

ikmal.ignoredRules.description: LanguageTool rule IDs suppressed from diagnostics.
